newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Zimbabwean shares weaken further on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Zimbabwean shares weaken further on Thursday.

text.p: Zimbabwe's industrial shares were active though weaker on Thursday, causing the key index to shed 10.35 points to 10,283.61, brokers said.
They said the index continued weighed down by investors' desertion of the bourse in favour of the local money market where firmer short-term trading rates promised them more attractive returns.

Thursday's losers included clothing and furniture retailers Tedco and tobacco firm TSL which both eased 10 cents to 260 and 630 respectively, while Alloys dropped 40 cents to 250 and Zimbabwe Sugar Refineries took a 50-cent knock to 1,500.
In minings, gold producers Falgold, copper company Mhangura and coal miners Wankie traded unchanged from Wednesday's levels, and the seven-share index there also closed at a steady 958.29.
